title: Seasonal Capsule Completion Rate
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:wardrobe season=* capsule_ready=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(capsule_ready="yes",1,0))) as matched by season
| eval a_complete_capsule_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_complete_capsule_pct
description: Measures the percentage of capsule wardrobes that end with a complete capsule by season.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which season are helping or hurting capsule wardrobes.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a complete capsule` on `style:wardrobe` events and summarize the hit rate by `season`.
visualization: Table of season with percentage of capsule wardrobes ending with a complete capsule.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how often a complete capsule happens for each season so you can see where capsule wardrobes go smoothly or get stuck.
